title: Get Media Buy Artifacts Response
description: Response containing content artifacts from a media buy for validation

media_buy_id.description: Media buy these artifacts belong to

artifacts.description: Delivery records with full artifact content

record_id.description: Unique identifier for this delivery record

package_id.description: Which package this delivery belongs to

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code where delivery occurred

channel.description: Channel type (e.g., display, video, audio, social)

brand_context.description: Brand information for policy evaluation. Schema TBD - placeholder for brand identifiers.

local_verdict.x-deprecated-enum-values-doc: Deprecated in 3.3 and removed in 4.0 (#8791): `pass` is a Python keyword, so generated SDKs must rename it. Use `passed`. Receivers accept both values through 3.x. Send the replacement only to a counterparty on AdCP 3.3 or later, because a 3.2 validator rejects it.
local_verdict.description: Seller's local model verdict for this artifact. `passed` replaces `pass`, which is deprecated in 3.3 and removed in 4.0; buyers treat the two as the same verdict.

collection_info.description: Information about artifact collection for this media buy. Sampling is configured at buy creation time — this reports what was actually collected.

total_deliveries.description: Total deliveries in the requested time range

total_collected.description: Total artifacts collected (per the buy's sampling configuration)

returned_count.description: Number of artifacts in this response (may be less than total_collected due to pagination or filters)
